author: Legoche
body:
The Map:
http://imgur.com/a/Yv2QS
Supplies:
http://imgur.com/a/KvxML


Me and Budah finished our map, designed for scrims. It was based off Senex 2.

The map is getting it's final touches, I am going to add a drop down spawn, but then, it should be done. (The void world will be fixed, normal terrain generated)

-The map only has 12 iron blocks on each side
-The rest of the blocks are gold
-The main healing supply is Instant Health Pots, not gapples.
-Supplies are below spawn, it contains wood items, water buckets, wool, glass and clay.
-Front line chests contain power 1 bow, 2 stacks of arrows and few healing pots.
-Designed to be heavily skybridge based
-One Monument
Opinions?
